items.text: To list computer, Excel and language skills on a resume, name the specific tool or language, show a level only if it is honest, and add one line of proof such as a task you did, so that a recruiter can tell what you can actually do.
Use a short skills section with specific tools, add a result in your experience or projects, and use simple level words that you can demonstrate in a test.
Do not claim advanced skills you cannot show.
